name: public-release-prep
details:
Comprehensive plan for preparing memory-mcp repository for clean public release. This includes setting up proper memory system, cleanup, documentation updates, licensing, and final review.

The repo will serve dual purposes:
1. Production-ready MCP server for public use
2. Example of best practices for using memory-mcp in Claude Code projects

Target: Ready for npm publish and GitHub release

tasks.name: Setup Project Memory System
tasks.details:
Transform this repo into an example of memory-mcp usage. Create ./.project_memory/ with organized structure demonstrating best practices. Document architecture decisions, development patterns, and project knowledge.

Reference: ~/projects/mcp-ts-api/ as template for structure and organization.

sub_tasks.name: Create memory directory structure
sub_tasks.details:
Set up ./.project_memory/memories/ with logical hierarchy:
- architecture/ - Design decisions, patterns
- development/ - Dev workflow, conventions
- testing/ - Test strategies, results
- releases/ - Version history, milestones

sub_tasks.name: Document architecture decisions
sub_tasks.details:
Create architecture/*.md files documenting:
- RW lock design rationale
- Unified tool interface decision
- Path security approach
- Transport choices (stdio vs HTTP)

sub_tasks.name: Document development patterns
sub_tasks.details:
Create development/*.md files covering:
- TypeScript + ESM setup
- Testing strategy (unit + integration + E2E)
- e/code commenting conventions used
- Linting and code quality standards

sub_tasks.name: Update project .mcp.json
sub_tasks.details:
Configure project to use its own memory system:
- Add project_memory instance pointing to ./.project_memory
- Keep as example in README
- Document in CLAUDE.md

tasks.name: Repository Cleanup
tasks.details: Remove test artifacts, temporary files, and development clutter. Ensure only production-relevant files remain while keeping important development infrastructure (tests, CI, docs).

sub_tasks.name: Clean test artifacts
sub_tasks.details:
Remove/clean:
- .memory/ directory (test data from E2E)
- .notes/ directory (empty)
- .state/ directory (empty)
- Move INTEGRATION-TEST-RESULTS.md to docs/ or remove
- coverage/ already gitignored

sub_tasks.name: Audit .gitignore completeness
sub_tasks.details:
Ensure .gitignore covers:
- ✅ node_modules, dist, coverage (already covered)
- ✅ .notes, .state (already listed as .notes/)
- Verify .project_memory should be gitignored
- Add any missing patterns

sub_tasks.name: Clean .plans directory
sub_tasks.details:
Review archived plans:
- Keep archived/ structure (shows development history)
- Ensure no sensitive info in plan files
- Current plan will be archived at session end

tasks.name: Fix System-Specific Hardcoding
tasks.details: Audit codebase for machine-specific paths, user names, or configurations. Ensure everything uses relative paths or environment variables.

sub_tasks.name: Audit source code paths
sub_tasks.details:
Search for hardcoded paths in src/:
- ✅ Already verified: no /home/ paths
- ✅ Default memoryRoot already relative: ./.memory
- Verify debug log path /tmp/memory-mcp/ is acceptable
- Check for any username references

sub_tasks.name: Audit configuration files
sub_tasks.details:
Check:
- .mcp.json has /home/jan/ paths - update to relative example
- package.json metadata - looks good
- tsconfig.json - check for absolute paths

sub_tasks.name: Audit documentation
sub_tasks.details:
Search docs and README for:
- /home/user/ examples (already present - verify they're generic)
- System-specific instructions
- Machine-specific assumptions

tasks.name: Documentation Updates
tasks.details: Ensure all documentation is accurate, complete, and polished for public release. Add missing files and improve existing ones.

sub_tasks.name: Update README.md
sub_tasks.details:
Enhancements:
- Add project-specific .mcp.json example (project_memory vs system_memory)
- Clarify default path is relative ./.memory
- Show both local project and global ~/.claude.json examples
- Add npm installation instructions (once published)
- Verify all examples are accurate
- Polish contributing section

sub_tasks.details:
Add MIT license file (license already declared in package.json).
Include:

sub_tasks.details:
Document version history:
- v0.1.0 (current) - Initial release

  - Tree view mode
  - RW locks (38x speedup)
  - stdio and HTTP transports
  - Path security (27 tests)
  - Production ready (85 tests + E2E)
- Keep format for future updates

sub_tasks.details:
Prepare CLAUDE.md for public repo:
- Keep project overview and architecture
- Keep technical details (useful for contributors)
- Update session handoff to be more general

- Keep e/code and e/coll references (good practices)
- Update 'Next Steps' to reflect public release status

tasks.name: Pre-Release Verification
tasks.details: Final checks before public release. Ensure everything works, builds, tests pass, and code quality is high.

sub_tasks.name: Run full test suite
sub_tasks.details:
Verify all tests pass:
- npm test (85 unit tests)
- npm run test:coverage (verify 80%+ coverage)
- Integration tests
- Lint checks (npm run lint)

sub_tasks.details:

- rm -rf dist/

- Verify dist/ structure

sub_tasks.details:

- repository field (add GitHub URL)
- homepage field (add GitHub URL)
- bugs field (add GitHub issues URL)

sub_tasks.details:
